name: Regulatory Information Management
one_liner: Products, registrations, submissions and commitments across markets in one system.
fits_when: the company holds or plans marketing authorisations for many products across many countries
registrations, renewals and expiry dates are tracked in spreadsheets per affiliate
a global regulatory lead plans submissions and approves dossiers before an affiliate files them
health authorities send questions with response deadlines that must not be missed
conditions of approval and post-approval commitments need an owner, a due date and a sign-off
affiliate RA teams should see and edit only their own markets
gives_you: A product registry with a product 360 page showing every market's registration, submission and commitment
A registration register per product and market with approval, expiry and renewal tracking
Submission lifecycle from planning through dossier preparation, internal review, filing, HA questions and decision
Post-approval commitments with due dates, evidence and sign-off
A portfolio dashboard: product-by-market status, renewals due and HA decisions coming up
Row-level access so affiliate RA users see only the markets they cover

catalogue.description: One regulatory system of record across markets. The regulatory lead keeps the product registry, plans submissions and approves dossiers, affiliate RA teams file locally, track their registrations and renewals and work on commitments, and leadership sees the whole portfolio: what is approved where, what is under review, what expires soon and which commitments are overdue.

packages.name: workflow
packages.description: Registration, submission and commitment lifecycles with role-gated steps

packages.name: documents
packages.description: Dossier links, approval letters and commitment evidence

packages.name: tasks
packages.description: Renewal reminders, HA response deadlines and commitment due dates

packages.name: reports
packages.description: Portfolio matrix, approvals by market and overdue commitments

roles.name: Regulatory lead
roles.description: Owns the product registry, plans submissions, approves dossiers for filing and signs off commitments

roles.name: Affiliate RA
roles.description: Keeps their markets' registrations current, files submissions, answers HA questions and works on local commitments

roles.name: Leadership
roles.description: Read-only portfolio view of approvals, renewals and overdue commitments across markets

workflows.name: Product registry
workflows.description: Products with their active ingredient, form, strengths and lifecycle from development to discontinuation

workflows.name: Registrations
workflows.description: Marketing authorisation per product and market: planned, filed, approved, in renewal, lapsed or withdrawn, with expiry alerts

workflows.name: Submissions
workflows.description: Plan, prepare, review internally, file, answer HA questions and record the decision

workflows.name: Commitments
workflows.description: Post-approval conditions with owner, due date, evidence and sign-off

compliance: Audit trail of every status change and approval, aligned to 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 expectations
Dossier approval before filing, by a different person from the one who prepared it
Commitment sign-off with evidence, so health-authority conditions are provably met
Renewal and HA response deadlines tracked so no authorisation lapses unnoticed
Affiliate users scoped to their own markets
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: Regulatory information management for 36 generic products across 18 markets in APAC, the Middle East and Latin America. The global regulatory lead plans submission waves and approves every dossier, affiliate RA teams file locally, answer health-authority questions and keep renewals current, and leadership sees the product-by-market portfolio. Post-approval commitments are maker-checker: the affiliate submits evidence and a regulatory lead signs it off.

changelog: Preview sketches for every custom screen (dashboards, custom tabs and panels).
